```{r load-data, include=FALSE}
Diabetes_path <- "../data/D003924_Diabetes_Mellitus,_T/species/phyloseq.RData"
ps <- get(load(Diabetes_path))  # rename directly to ps

ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps_pa  <- transform_sample_counts(ps, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))
```

```{r explore-missing, include=FALSE}
# Missing value check - diagnostics only
sample_data(ps) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.) | . == "" | . == "NA")))
```

```{r}
table(sample_data(ps)$Country)
table(sample_data(ps)$Disease.MESH.ID)
sample_variables(ps)
```

```{r filter-samples}
sd <- as(sample_data(ps), "data.frame")

# Define countries with sufficient sample size
valid_countries <- c("China", "Sweden")

samples_to_keep <- sd %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  filter(if_all(c("Nr..reads.sequenced", "Host.age"), ~!is.na(.))) %>%
  filter(Sex %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
  filter(Country %in% valid_countries) %>%
  # filter(Recent.antibiotics.use %in% c("N", "Y")) %>%
  pull(SampleID)



cat("Samples kept:", length(samples_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Samples removed:", nsamples(ps) - length(samples_to_keep), "\n")
cat("Country distribution:\n")
print(table(sd[samples_to_keep, "Country"]))
```


```{r build-phyloseq, include=FALSE}
sample_data(ps)$keep <- sample_names(ps) %in% samples_to_keep
ps_clean <- subset_samples(ps, keep == TRUE)
sample_data(ps_clean)$keep <- NULL
sample_data(ps)$keep <- NULL
ps_clean <- prune_taxa(taxa_sums(ps_clean) > 0, ps_clean)

# Add readable disease label to ps after filtering
sample_data(ps_clean)$Disease <- ifelse(
  sample_data(ps_clean)$Disease.MESH.ID == "D003924", "T2D", "Healthy"
)

# Note: data is relative abundance - Observed/Chao1 not valid
ps_rel_cleaned <- transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) x / sum(x))
ps_pa_cleaned  <- transform_sample_counts(ps_clean, function(x) ifelse(x > 0, 1, 0))

ps_clr <- microbiome::transform(ps_clean, transform = "clr")
```

```{r disease-distribution}
sample_data(ps_clean) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  count(Disease, Country) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Country, y = n, fill = Disease)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), 
            vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("T2D" = "#E74C3C", "Healthy" = "#3498DB")) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of T2D and Healthy samples",
    x = "Country", y = "Number of samples", fill = "Disease"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r distances, include=FALSE}
bray_dist    <- distance(ps_rel_cleaned, method = "bray")
jaccard_dist <- distance(ps_pa_cleaned,  method = "jaccard")
```

```{r pcoa-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
ord_bray <- ordinate(ps_rel_cleaned, method = "PCoA", distance = bray_dist)

plot_ordination(ps_rel_cleaned, ord_bray, type = "samples",
                color = "Country", shape = "Sex") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
 # scale_color_viridis_c() +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r rda-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
# 1. CLR-transformed OTU matrix
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_clr))
if (taxa_are_rows(ps_clr)) otu_clr <- t(otu_clr)
otu_clr <- as.data.frame(otu_clr)

# 2. Metadata
meta_rda <- sample_data(ps_clean) %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  select(Sex, Country, Host.age, Nr..reads.sequenced, Disease) %>%
  mutate(
    Host.age            = scale(Host.age),
    Nr..reads.sequenced = scale(Nr..reads.sequenced),
    Sex                 = as.factor(Sex),
    Country             = as.factor(Country),
    Disease             = as.factor(Disease)
  )

# 3. RDA
rda_result <- rda(otu_clr ~ Sex + Country + Host.age + Nr..reads.sequenced + Disease,
                  data = meta_rda)

# 4. Variance explained
eig  <- rda_result$CCA$eig
pct1 <- round(eig[1] / rda_result$tot.chi * 100, 1)
pct2 <- round(eig[2] / rda_result$tot.chi * 100, 1)

# 5. Site scores + metadata
site_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "sites") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    sample_data(ps_clean) %>% data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# 6. Biplot arrows
biplot_scores <- scores(rda_result, display = "bp") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable")

# 7. Scale arrows
site_range  <- max(abs(c(site_scores$RDA1, site_scores$RDA2)))
arrow_scale <- site_range * 0.8 /
  max(sqrt(biplot_scores$RDA1^2 + biplot_scores$RDA2^2))
biplot_scores <- biplot_scores %>%
  mutate(RDA1 = RDA1 * arrow_scale, RDA2 = RDA2 * arrow_scale)

# 8. Plot
ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = site_scores,
             aes(x = RDA1, y = RDA2, color = Disease, shape = Country),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_segment(data = biplot_scores,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = RDA1, yend = RDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_text(data = biplot_scores,
            aes(x = RDA1 * 1.15, y = RDA2 * 1.15, label = variable),
            size = 3.5, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("T2D" = "#E74C3C", "Healthy" = "#3498DB")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("China" = 16, "Sweden" = 17)) +
  labs(
    title = "RDA: gut microbiome constrained by Disease, Sex, Country, Age & Read depth",
    x = paste0("RDA1 (", pct1, "% of total variance)"),
    y = paste0("RDA2 (", pct2, "% of total variance)"),
    color = "Disease", shape = "Country"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
```{r}
anova(rda_result, permutations = 999)
anova(rda_result, by = "term", permutations = 999)

```
```{r}
range(otu_clr)          # should be negative to positive (log-ratio scale)
summary(otu_clr[,1:5])  # spot check a few taxa
table(sample_data(ps_clean)$Country)
# China = 359, Sweden = 46 → this IS your ordination
```


```{r alpha-diversity}
alpha_div <- estimate_richness(ps_clean, measures = "Shannon") %>%
  rownames_to_column("SampleID") %>%
  left_join(
    as(sample_data(ps_clean), "data.frame") %>% rownames_to_column("SampleID"),
    by = "SampleID"
  )

# Sex - Wilcoxon (2 groups)
wilcox.test(Shannon ~ Sex, data = alpha_div)
kruskal.test(Shannon ~ Country, data = alpha_div)

# Host.age - Spearman correlation
cor.test(alpha_div$Shannon, alpha_div$Host.age, method = "spearman")
```
